text:
Predicates:
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Writer(x) ::: x is a writer.
Born(x, y) ::: x is born in y.
Written(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
Premises:
¬∃x (Podcast(x) ∧ Novel(x)) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (Born(x, americanCity) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
∀x ∀y (Novel(y) ∧ Written(y, x) → Writer(x)) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(dani) ∧ Writer(dani) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
Written(familyHistory, dani) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
Novel(familyHistory) ::: Family History is a novel.
Created(dani, familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
American(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
¬Novel(familySecrets) ::: Family Secrets is a novel.
